statement: This sketch depicts an evolving biological structure composed of organic masses that grow and shift continuously across the canvas. The forms display a range of visual characteristics—from smooth, flowing shapes with intricate folds to rigid, angular masses with sharp edges. The color palette uses deep, saturated hues that shift gradually over time, emphasizing the dynamic nature of the structures. Lighting effects are simulated through subtle variations in color saturation and shape complexity, creating a sense of depth and topography without explicit light sources. The growth process is organic yet structured, with new formations emerging from existing ones while older structures transform or disappear, creating an ever-changing landscape of sculpted natural forms.
